claim: subject rides a travelling wave displacement as you scroll

q1_defects.answer: No defects. Card rocks and bobs cleanly; chrome sharp at DPR-2; full card look intact at every phase. bandingScore 0.33-0.44 is the standard panel material.

q2_reads_as.answer: Reads as riding a travelling wave: idle=card tilted up-right on a crest, play-1=rolled the other way and lower in a trough, play-3=tilted up-right again on the next crest with a different vertical position. The card rocks/banks as the wave passes. Full card chrome preserved, matches ground truth.

q3_discoverable.answer: Yes, all 4 controls read. swellAmp scales the roll amplitude (low near-level, high big tilt); wavelength changes wave phase/shape at the pinned point; rollCoupling is the clearest (low flat, high strongly banked); chop changes the pose to a sharper angle. All visibly distinct.

q4_responsive.answer: Responsive: card rocks across play frames, frameDeltaMag 9.55 / 8.73 / 10.35; controls apply ~570-587ms, all changed:true.

q5_net.answer: PLEASED — the card convincingly rides a swell, rocking on crests and troughs, the card look is never lost, and all four knobs do sensible things.
